title: Fixed joint keeps two spheres welded while they fly and spin; a hinge keeps spin about its axis and removes spin off it

residual_m.derivation: requirement: a weld holds to 1e-4 of the radius (0.1 m). The drift it fights is w^2 r h^2 = 3.3e-8 m per substep; one Jacobi iteration of the coupled positional and angular constraints removes only a few percent of it per substep, so the steady residual (9.3e-7 m measured on the reference substrate) is not a fixed fraction of the drift that can be derived here

residual_rad.derivation: both bodies spin with the same w, so the relative orientation only changes through rounding of the quaternion updates (<= 4u per substep, removed at least by half each substep: 8u) and of the residual measurement; 64u
residual_rad.source: u = 2^-23 (WGSL rounding direction unspecified, §15.7.4: faithful rounding)

residual_m.derivation: the anchor is the centre, so only rounding moves it
residual_m.source: u = 2^-23 (WGSL rounding direction unspecified, §15.7.4: faithful rounding)

residual_rad.derivation: the off-axis tilt is at least halved every substep (n = 2: positional and angular constraint); what remains is the quaternion update's rounding, <= 4u per substep, so <= 8u steady, doubled for the residual's own rounding: 16u

spin_rel.derivation: corrections act along a x b, perpendicular to the axis, so the spin about the axis only sees rounding
spin_rel.source: u = 2^-23 (WGSL rounding direction unspecified, §15.7.4: faithful rounding)

off_axis_rad_s.derivation: the initial 0.3 rad/s off the axis is at least halved per substep (gone after one record, 400 substeps); what remains is the quaternion update rounding the axis by <= 4u per substep while spinning at 5 rad/s, which the hinge correction turns into a rate of tilt / h: 16u / h
